title: Texas Roadhouse Surreal Collage
description: A vibrant surreal collage features the Texas Roadhouse logo and a large golden fleur-de-lis at center. Visible elements include a stone Texas Roadhouse sign with a crow and yellow bird, a platter of glazed ribs and corn on the cob, a wooden building labeled 'Fresh Baked Bread' with bread and beer, a hand holding a margarita, a large steak, and a dramatic woman's face with bared teeth on the right.
prompt: Surreal fantasy collage featuring prominent Texas Roadhouse branding and a large golden fleur-de-lis floating in a purple cosmic sky. A stone Texas Roadhouse sign with a black crow and small yellow bird sits on the left beside a stone table holding steaming glazed ribs and corn. A wooden 'Fresh Baked Bread' building with loaves and beer appears below. A gloved hand holds a margarita next to a large cooked steak. On the right, a dramatic close-up of a woman's face with fierce expression and bared teeth. Floating orbs, classical architecture, and swirling clouds fill the background.
